official_source.rights: CC0; official API README also declares personal and commercial use

oracle_discrepancy_and_resolution.timing: corrected prospectively after bounded diagnostic and before implementation lock or any formal report

interpretation: One exact CC0 Poly Haven Radiance file is decoded by a strict project-owned new-style scanline-RLE parser using Radiance's official half-bin RGBE convention. OpenCV independently verifies the container, RLE and code bytes but uses a lower-bin numeric convention; the preregistered correction makes that discrepancy explicit instead of treating OpenCV as the color-value authority.
stop_rule: Do not assign primaries or a white point, convert this result to WorkingImage, generalize to arbitrary Radiance files, replace official half-bin semantics with OpenCV lower-bin values, or map this private primitive to a package/capability/product claim.
claim_ceiling: Private exact-source Radiance RGBE arithmetic/container primitive producing unlabelled linear RGB radiance only; no primaries, white point, WorkingImage, arbitrary HDR support, package/schema/capability/product admission or candidate 3.
